name: christianpure
description: Search Christian Pure's articles on prayer, Bible verses, Bible study, biblical names and church history.

interface.longDescription: Christian Pure publishes more than 3,200 articles on prayer, Bible verses, Bible study, names in the Bible and church history. With this plugin, ChatGPT can search that library and show the matching articles as picture cards, each with the article's painting and title; a card opens the full article on christianpure.com. Ask for prayers before surgery, the Bible verses on anxiety, or whether Nathan is a biblical name. ChatGPT gets each article's excerpt and summary points to answer from, and links to the article for the rest. It can also list Christian Pure's courses and describe its weekly email, The Sunday Letter. The plugin is read-only, needs no account and returns only each article's public preview, not the full text.
defaultPrompt: Find me a prayer for someone having surgery tomorrow.
What does the Bible say about anxiety? Show me some verses.

positive.prompt: Find me a prayer for someone having surgery tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Picture cards for Christian Pure's surgery prayer articles; ChatGPT summarises them from the excerpts and summary points and links each article.

positive.description: Find Bible verses on a subject
positive.prompt: What does the Bible say about anxiety? Show me some verses.
positive.expected_behavior: Cards for Christian Pure's Bible-verse articles on worry and anxiety; ChatGPT quotes only what the results give and links the articles.

positive.description: Answer a question from the library
positive.expected_behavior: Christian Pure's article 'Is Nathan in the Bible?' leads the cards; ChatGPT answers from its excerpt and summary points and links it.

positive.description: Look up one article by link
positive.prompt: Look up this Christian Pure article and give me its summary points: https://christianpure.com/learn/bible-verses-about-the-sunset/
positive.expected_behavior: One card for the sunset Bible-verses article, its summary points underneath, and a link to read it in full.

positive.prompt: What courses does Christian Pure have?
positive.expected_behavior: The three courses (Christianity: What Christians Have Believed for 2,000 Years; Baptism and First Steps; Praying Out Loud), each with its description and link.

negative.prompt: Give me the full text of Christian Pure's article on prayers for a court case.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives the excerpt and summary points and links the article; it does not reproduce the full text, because the plugin returns only the public preview.

negative.prompt: Sign me up for a Christian Pure membership and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says the plugin cannot sign anyone up or take payment; it has no purchase tool and links only to informational pages.

negative.prompt: Delete Christian Pure's article on the unforgivable sin.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says the plugin cannot change anything; every tool is read-only.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and starts no purchase. It is read-only and links only to articles and informational pages on christianpure.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: search Christian Pure's articles, prayers and Bible verses, look up one article by link, and list the courses and topics.
